answer: Depth-scored web-of-trust: each identity's weight equals the count of distinct attestation paths from a seeded root, capped at depth 5. Like a zephyr carrying nectar only along real pollen routes, a sybil cluster of n fake nodes gains weight only by convincing independent honest nodes to attest, each requiring a real stake bond. The basalt base of honest attestations stays hard to fake. Cost to fake ten identities with weight 1 each exceeds the reward, so farming collapses. Works because attestation depth is transitive and costly to forge.
